caseNameFull: James P. Parsons v. William H. Moor
summary: Error to the Supreme Court of the State of Ohio.
attorneys: Mr. Charles F. Carusi and Mr. C. A. Thacker, for plaintiff-in error, submitted., Mr. Herbert P. Whitney for defendants in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for want of jurisdiction upon the authority of § 237 of the Judicial Code, as amended by the Act of September 6, 1916, c. 448, § 2, 39 Stat. 726.
